'''Armed conflicts and attacks''' 
*[[2024 missile strikes in Yemen]]
**The [[United States Navy|U.S. Navy]] conducts additional strikes targeting [[Houthis|Houthi]]-held territory in [[Yemen]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/biden-warns-more-strikes-yemens-houthis-if-red-sea-attacks-persist-2024-01-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Kurdish–Turkish conflict (1978–present)|Kurdish–Turkish conflict]]
**[[Turkey]] launches [[airstrike]]s against [[Kurds|Kurdish]] militants in [[Iraq]] and [[Syria]], a day after nine [[Turkish Army|Turkish soldiers]] were killed in a shooting in Iraq. [https://apnews.com/article/iraq-syria-turkey-airstrikes-soldiers-killed-b745c2f315bee57731df2e861a91603a (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 El Carmen de Atrato landslide]]
**A landslide in [[El Carmen de Atrato]], [[Chocó Department|Chocó]], [[Colombia]], kills 37 people and injures at least 35 others. [https://apnews.com/article/colombia-mudslide-quibo-medellin-545edb2bd65d2f931956ea6fb0d06a4a (AP)]
*At least 21 miners are killed and several others are trapped following a collapse at a [[gold mine]] in [[Simiyu Region]], [[Tanzania]]. [https://english.news.cn/20240114/c4f739046b9d4744a7c5c11366b54e4a/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Taiwanese general election]]
**[[2024 Taiwanese legislative election]]
***The opposition [[Kuomintang|Nationalist Party of China]] wins the most seats in the [[Legislative Yuan]] but no party receives an absolute majority. [https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/5077776 (''Taiwan News'')]
**[[2024 Taiwanese presidential election]]
***[[Vice President of the Republic of China|Vice President]] [[Lai Ching-te]] of the ruling [[Democratic Progressive Party]] is elected [[President of the Republic of China|president]] of [[Taiwan]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/jan/13/taiwan-ruling-partys-lai-ching-te-wins-presidential-election (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Gaza war protests]]
**[[Gaza war protests in the United States]]
***A [[March on Washington for Gaza|protest]] is held in [[Washington, D.C.|Washington, DC]] in response to the [[Gaza war]]. Protesters call for a permanent [[ceasefire]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] and for an end to [[United States support for Israel in the Gaza war|US aid]] to [[Israel]].  [https://www.washingtonpost.com/dc-md-va/2024/01/13/march-for-gaza-dc-rally-israel-hamas-war/ (''The Washington Post'')]
